brief: A stripe design inspired by Lepcha thara: groups of ten vertical stripes with a thick-thin-thin-thick width rhythm, ordered palette white-red-yellow-green-black repeated twice per group, and one band per group carrying a row of sideways chevrons with a 8 px period.
